name: Nili Lotan
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $335 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's tailored pants, Japanese denim, shirts, knitwear and leather, pants and jeans around $390–450, sold through its own stores, site and department stores.

quote.q: I’ve 100% owned this business from day one. I started the business with a very small investment of my own.

opview: “I’ve 100% owned this business from day one. I started the business with a very small investment of my own.” — Nili Lotan, founder and CEO, Glossy

facts_read.source: brand site (Nili's Story, Nili's World); Glossy 2022-05-04; nordstrom.com; Vinted brand page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Nili Lotan women's ready-to-wear and shoes; EXCLUDED: Nili Lotan men's (tagged mens-*), Nili Lotan x TKEES collaboration, swimwear, handbags, accessories

doors.note: site nililotan.com; 8 US stores, all own doors (incl. NILI LOTAN DENIM on Duane Street, next to the Tribeca store); no outlets, concessions or coming-soon; no per-store pages, so source_url is the locator page; brand writes NILI LOTAN, key Nili Lotan
